notes: batch_id is user-supplied grouping metadata, not an instrument serial number; individual physical-device IDs are not required for batch-level analysis
filename index pairing remains directory/run scoped and does not establish one continuous device history
B1500 primary compliance configuration is preserved separately from observed peak current
bias compliance values are retained as raw multi-channel metadata strings
R-read state candidates use R-read(2) after SET and R-read(1)(1) immediately after RESET at matched read bias
the >=20 read contrast and 3.5-MAD flags are provisional review rules; cycles are not deleted
retention slopes are descriptive and depend on reported B1500 time values
